senses.gloss:
Name,Ⓒs.ⒹnAman n., nAmaDeyaM; aBiDA, aBi-DAnaM, AKyA, saMjYA, aBiDeyaM, AhvayaH, AhvA, upADiH, lakzaRaM, vyapadeSaH; ‘do you know them by n(ame)’ api jYAyaMte te nAmaDeyataH; ‘I shall ask his motherʼs n(ame)’ asya mAtaraM nAmataH; pfcCeyaM (S. 7); ‘call by n(ame)’ nAma grah 9 U, saMbuD c., nAmnA Ahve 1 P; ‘calling by n(ame)’ nAmagrahaH-haRaM, saMboDanaM; ‘he calls me by my n(ame)’ nAmagrAhaM mAmAhvayati; ‘family n(ame)’ upanAma, kulanAma; ‘in oneʼs n(ame)’ vacanena, vacanAt; ‘say to the king in my n(ame)’ vAcyastvayA madvacanAtsa rAjA (R. xiv. 61); ‘what is the n(ame) of the sage’ kiMnAmaDeyosO muniH; ‘in the n(ame) of’ (in oaths) sAkzIkftya.
Ⓑ
 2 pratizWA, kIrti-KyAti-prasidDi-viSruti f., pra-, vi-, KyAtiH, yaSas n.; ‘who has made a n(ame)’ labDapratizWaH; ‘good n(ame)’ sukIrtiH, suKyAtiH; ‘bad n(ame)’ apa-a-kIrtiH, duzkIrtiH, apratizWA.
Ⓔv. t.ⒹaBi-DA 3 U, Ahve 1 P, AKyA 2 P, A-pra-cakz 2 A, udAhf 1 P, vyapadiS 6 P, saMjYAM-nAma-kf 8 U (with gen.); See Call; ‘hence his father n(am)ed his son Aja after the Creator’ ataH pitA brahmaRa eva nAmnA tamA-tmajanmAnamajaM cakAra (R. v. 36).
Ⓑ
 2 nAmnA nirdiS 6 P or udA-vyA-hf, nAmataH kaT 10 or vac 2 P or brU 2 U or kFt 10, nAma grah; See Tell also.
Ⓝ[Nam]ed,Ⓒ‘by name’, a.ⒹaBihita, KyAta, saMjYita, kIrtita, udAhfta, vyapa-dizwa gen. ex. by nAma ind., or by (s.) in comp.; ‘a son n(amed) Rāma’ rAmanAmA or rAmo nAma or rAmasaMjYaH putraH.
Ⓑ
 2 nAmaDArin, kfta-labDa-prApta-nAman.
Ⓝ[Nam]ing,Ⓒs.ⒹnAmakaraRaM, nAmanirdeSaH-grahaRaM.
Ⓝ[Name]less,Ⓒa.ⒹanAmaka, nAmahIna, aprasidDa.
Ⓝ[Name]ly,Ⓒadv.ⒹyaTA, nAma; ex. by tadyaTA, (viraktAnAM dviviDaM prativiDAnaM tadyaTA anugraho nigrahaSca Mu. 3).
ⓃNamesake,Ⓒs.Ⓓeka-sama-nAmakaH, ekanAmaDArin m., sanAman m.
